MINUTES
  MALIBU ARTS COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  APRIL 22, 2025
  CROSS CREEK RANCH SHOPPING CENTER. THE PLAZA
  9:30 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Haldeman called tha meeting t0 order at 9:36 a.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Barry Haldeman; Vice Chair Peter Jones; Commissioners Lotte Cherin,
  Pamela Conley Ulich, and Dennis Smith

  ALSO PRESENT: Alexis Brown, Deputy City Manager; Kristin Riesgo, Community
  Services Director; Cynthia Alba, Management Analyst; and Brittany Saleaumua,
  Administrative Assistant

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Commissioner Cherin moved, and Vice Chair Jones seconded a motion to approve
  the agenda. The question was called. and the motion carried unanimously.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported the meeting agenda was properly posted on
  April l6, 2025.

  None.

ITEM 2.A.  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  None.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  Parcel C Performing Arts Center
  i
  Recommended Action: Receive and file an update from Cross Creek Ranch on the
  Performing Arts Center Conceptual Design located on Parcel C.

  Community Services Director Riesgo introduced Bryan Gordon, owner and
  developer ofthe Cross Creek Ranch Shopping Center.

  Meeting at Parcel C.

  Bryan Gordon discussed the land features and general layout of Parcel C. Mr.
  Gordon stated that the land‘s shape was irregular, with a hill in the center. but two
  areas could be developed. He stated Parcel C would be on the City’s sewer system.
  He stated additional parking would be required, but Cross Creek Ranch would work
  with the City to supply half of the parking due to the settlement agreement.

  The meeting moved to the Cross Creek Ranch plaza area.

  Mr. Gordon presented the conceptual design of the Malibu Performing Arts Center.
  which encompassed two buildings: one building included two theaters. a basement
  storage room, loading dock, and backstage room, and the second building contained
  an area for exhibitions/galleries, multipurpose art rooms/studios and a basement
  storage room.

  Speakers: Deborah Frankel. Shoshana Kuttner, Julie Carmen. David Katz. Howard
  Runzki. A. Jones. David Von Oeyen. and Christine Waljeski.

  Mr. Gordon and staffanswered Commissioner questions.

  Mr. Gordon stated the designs were conceptual. He stated the design was not
  finalized and would be reconfigured based on community and Malibu Arts
  Commissioner feedback.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes ofApril 22, 2025
  Page 3 0f4

CONSENSUS
  By Consensus. the Commission agreed to host a community workshop to gain
  community feedback on the conceptual design of the Malibu Performing Arts
  Center.

  . Cross Creek Ranch Parcel C Ad Hoc Committee Appointment
  Recommended Action: Confirm or modify the appointment of two Ad Hoc
  Committee members tasked with participating in the conceptual design process for
  a Performing Arts Center at Cross Creek Ranch Parcel C.

  Deputy City Manager Brown presented the staffreport.

  The Commission discussed whether to reaffirm or appoint new Commissioners to
  serve on the ad hoc.

  In response to the Commission. Deputy City Manager Brown stated it would not
  be possible for Commissioners to work on different aspects or phases ofthe Malibu
  Performing Arts Center since it would violate the Brown Act. She stated
  fundraising could not be conducted until a cost estimate was determined.

MOTION  Chair Haldeman moved, and Commissioner Smith seconded a motion to affirm
  appointing Vice Chair Jones and Commissioner Cherin to serve on the Parcel C
  Performing Arts Center Ad Hoc during the design and concept phase ofthe project.
  The Commission would review the appointment in two months. The question was
  called, and the motion carried unanimously.
